# meshtastic-mcp

> MCP server + agent skills for AI tooling to discover, drive, observe, and test Meshtastic
> devices and the apps that talk to them. Portable core (serial/TCP device admin + recorder +
> replay/simulated-device streaming with a synthetic-mesh generator and fuzzer, plus nRF52
> UF2 bootloader flashing), with optional firmware (build/flash), android/apple emulator
> (hardware-free e2e), local-model offload, and RTL-SDR RF-compliance capabilities, plus
> FleetSuite, a local web control plane for a multi-board hardware bench ([web] extra,
> `meshtastic-mcp-web`).
> Run `meshtastic-mcp doctor` (or the `doctor` tool) to see + acquire any missing dependencies.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): install, capabilities, confirmations, builds and flashes, nRF52 UF2
  flashing and recovery, hardware-free e2e overview
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): architecture, capability model, rules, common workflows
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup + gates
- [SECURITY](SECURITY.md): confirmation gate, prompt-injection sources, elevated-risk tools
- [docs/confirmations.md](docs/confirmations.md): how destructive tools ask the human,
  `MESHTASTIC_MCP_CONFIRM`, and what `confirm=True` means
- [docs/background-jobs.md](docs/background-jobs.md): jobs, `job_id` polling, MCP background
  tasks (`[tasks]` extra), canceling builds and following flashes
- [docs/firmware-builds.md](docs/firmware-builds.md): build and flash arguments, `DEBUG_HEAP`,
  userPrefs, the ESP32 install/update scripts, fake node DBs
- [docs/serve.md](docs/serve.md): `meshtastic-mcp serve`, a token-authenticated HTTP server for a shared bench
- [docs/toolsets.md](docs/toolsets.md): `MESHTASTIC_MCP_TOOLSETS` / `MESHTASTIC_MCP_READ_ONLY`,
  the toolset groups, trimming the advertised tool list
- [docs/replay.md](docs/replay.md): `replay_start` parameters, the `sim_profile` keys, fuzz
  presets and the `replay_inject_*` tools
- [docs/display-mirror.md](docs/display-mirror.md): `capture_display`, `drive_display_start` and
  `send_input_event` on the device's own screen
- [docs/screenshot-set.md](docs/screenshot-set.md): matching Android and iOS screenshots on one
  simulated mesh, and connecting the iOS app to a replay node
- [docs/rf-oracle.md](docs/rf-oracle.md): the RTL-SDR on-air checks `rf_scan` and `rf_confirm_tx`
- [docs/local-models.md](docs/local-models.md): local-model offload (tools, backends, config)
- [docs/sdk-cli-bridge.md](docs/sdk-cli-bridge.md): experimental Kotlin-SDK device-IO backend
- [docs/vanity.md](docs/vanity.md): vanity NodeNums / app colors: grind (mvgrind), verify, apply
- [docs/discord.md](docs/discord.md): read-only Discord source tools (`discord_*`, the separate `meshtastic-mcp-discord` server) and token setup
- [docs/ble-sniffer.md](docs/ble-sniffer.md): off-device BLE capture of the phone<->node
  link (`ble_sniff_*`): nRF Sniffer dongle, pcap format, untrusted output
- [docs/power-meter.md](docs/power-meter.md): ImmersionRC RF power meter and the `pa_*` PA
  calibration tools
- [docs/atak-cot.md](docs/atak-cot.md): ATAK/iTAK CoT capture relay and the ATAK emulator fleet
- [docs/atak-cot-emission.md](docs/atak-cot-emission.md): ATAK-CIV CoT emission reference
- [docs/nightly.md](docs/nightly.md): FleetSuite nightly bake
- [docs/sim-realism-plan.md](docs/sim-realism-plan.md): calibrating the replay sim against real
  event captures
- [tests/README.md](tests/README.md): tiered hardware test suite + bench roles
- [docs/bench-setup.md](docs/bench-setup.md): set up your own hardware bench
- [web-ui/README.md](web-ui/README.md): FleetSuite SPA development

## Skills
- [meshtastic-device-ops](src/meshtastic_mcp/skills/meshtastic-device-ops/SKILL.md): discover,
  connect, configure, observe, recover, and flash devices via the MCP tool surface.
- [meshtastic-e2e](src/meshtastic_mcp/skills/meshtastic-e2e/SKILL.md): closed-loop device<->app
  testing; references/ has per-loop recipes and the emulator lab.
- [meshtastic-org-knowledge](src/meshtastic_mcp/skills/meshtastic-org-knowledge/SKILL.md):
  cross-repo questions about the Meshtastic GitHub org (status, docs, what changed).
